response.message: Astra: Your ACT attempted a graph check, but the tool stopped at an ImportError; it did not verify {A,C,E}. Put library repair aside and spend attention on the graph itself. An independent set contains no pair joined by an edge. Using AB, BC, CD, DE, EA, check each pair in your proposed set explicitly. What does that comparison establish? Give the pair checks and your resulting judgment, rather than printing a statement of confidence.
